segments.text: The password in data dot txt has been rotated by thirteen positions, the classic ROT thirteen cipher.
I log in as bandit11 with ssh bandit11@bandit.labs.overthewire.org -p 2220.
Thirteen is half of twenty-six, so the same shift applied again returns the original text; ROT thirteen is its own inverse.
I pipe the file through tr, mapping A to Z onto N to Z then A to M, and the lowercase range the same way.
The output reads, the password is, followed by the password for bandit twelve, and the level is solved.
